isolation.workspace: disposable git repository under /tmp (removed after capture)

observed.extensionLoads: real Pi binary loaded dist/extension.js via isolated profile
observed.durableServicesInitialize: store root <agent>/wayforge/tasks created at session start
observed.governedTaskStarts: /wayforge command created durable task alpha0-1 with checkpoint summary and workspace checkpoint
observed.checkpointWritten: state.json workspace checkpoint with repository identity and empty changed-path set
observed.lifecycleProjection: session end projected status cancelled through the real event path
observed.suspension: operator-authored explicit_reset wake with resumeNotBeforeMs in the past (deterministic controlled wake condition)
observed.restart: fresh real Pi process in the same isolated profile
observed.discovery: startup scan found the due suspension without blocking session start
observed.driftCheck: workspace digests compared; no drift; workspace file bytes unchanged
observed.resumingTransition: status resuming persisted with continuation alpha0-1:resume-1 reserved then launching
observed.newSession: not independently observed: the launch intent reached the real SDK factory boundary, but factory creation and prompt failures are collapsed by the launcher
observed.failSafe: launcher returned failure and task became blocked with continuation_outcome_ambiguous; exact factory-versus-prompt failure point was not captured
observed.duplicatePrevention: one persisted launch intent observed in this run; the deterministic tests separately exercise duplicate prevention

notProvenInSmoke: a continuation prompt that completes successfully (requires model credentials in the isolated profile; production credentials are forbidden)

test/live-restart-acceptance.test.ts proves extension composition across processes with a Pi host double and a doubled session factory behind the real launcher; it does not prove successful real SDK continuation
